input.summary: Build the right spinner with its three-bank, complete B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F, lock three balls in descending order, then repeat the left spinner during Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Right spinner
quickInfo.summary: Its three-bank raises the spinner from 500 to 5,000, and a clean sweep awards 50,000.

quickInfo.name: BLASTOFF
quickInfo.summary: Top lanes, standups, and return lanes complete B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F and enable the three-ball lock sequence.

quickInfo.name: Ball locks
quickInfo.summary: After BLASTOFF, the top-left chutes lock balls through the 5-4-3-2-1 sequence.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: The third lock starts Multiball, raises the left-spinner ceiling, and allows BLASTOFF to rebuild.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: The recessed center target and right three-bank advance the end-of-ball multiplier to 15x.

steps.text: From the right flipper, shoot the left orbit through the spinner and try to sweep its three-bank.
Repeat until the bank lamps are complete and the spinner scores 5,000.
Complete B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F through the top lanes, two B standups, and return lanes.
After BLASTOFF, use the top-left lock chutes and complete the descending 5-4-3-2-1 order.
Make the final required lock to start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, repeat the left spinner and rebuild BLASTOFF while the extra balls protect the shot.

fallback.title: Right-spinner control
fallback.when: Use this when the numbered lock targets or BLASTOFF standups are unsafe.

steps.text: Stop forcing the unsafe target.
Repeat the left orbit through the right spinner.
Use natural top and return-lane movement for BLASTOFF letters.
Keep building and cashing the spinner when Multiball is distant or a lead only needs separation.
Return to BLASTOFF and lock work only when the remaining qualifications are close and controllable, or when the Multiball ceiling is needed.

alternatives.title: Bonus-first ball
alternatives.when: Use this when Multiball is too far away and the recessed multiplier target is safe.

steps.text: Shoot the recessed center target or complete the right three-bank to advance Bonus X.
Return to the spinner after one clean multiplier advance.
Complete B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F.
Complete the descending lock sequence.
Start three-ball Multiball.
Use Multiball to repeat the left spinner and rebuild BLASTOFF.
Carry a built base bonus into the largest safe Bonus X.

techniques.name: Spinner-bank sweep
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left orbit from the right flipper so the ball crosses the spinner and clips all three nearby targets.

cautions.issue: Pop-bumper exits and direct target rebounds can send the ball out of control.
cautions.response: Avoid shooting the bumpers and take numbered targets only from a settled ball.

cautions.issue: A partial spinner shot can roll back through the center.
cautions.response: Use a full orbit shot and keep both flippers ready until the ball clears the spinner lane.

cautions.issue: The center post may be removed or fitted with a weak rubber in competition.
cautions.response: Inspect the post before play and do not plan on it saving a center drain.

cautions.issue: A shot into a lock chute during Multiball relocks that ball for the next Multiball and removes it from the current one.
cautions.response: Stay on the left spinner and avoid the lock chutes until single-ball play returns.

playfieldReferences.context: Use the right spinner beside the three-bank.
playfieldReferences.label: Right spinner and bank
playfieldReferences.description: Sweep the bank while raising the spinner value.

playfieldReferences.context: Use the numbered top-left lock chutes for each lock.
playfieldReferences.label: Ball locks
playfieldReferences.description: Complete the lit descending sequence after BLASTOFF.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the center post, Extra Ball conversion, and BLASTOFF lock settings.
Test both spinners, numbered targets, channels, locks, and bumper exits.
input.simpleOverview: Flight 2000 uses B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F to enable three locks that must be taken in descending 5-4-3-2-1 order. Build the right spinner first, complete B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F, take the three locks, then repeat the left spinner during Multiball.
input.overview: Flight 2000 uses B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F to enable three locks that must be taken in descending 5-4-3-2-1 order. Build the spinner and finish the word, then take the 5-4-3-2-1 chutes in order. During Multiball, repeat the left spinner and rebuild B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F while advancing Bonus X only from controlled center-target or bank shots.
